snippet.title: Well Keeper - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Well Keeper, an arcade action bullet hell roguelike developed by Corporate Potato. Players will take on waves of enemies by flapping a mouse's ears to evade incoming attacks. Acquire upgrades and abilities in Well Keeper, launching on April 23 for PC (Steam).
